business_summary: China Shipbuilding Industry Group Power Co., Ltd. manufactures and supplies power equipment in China and internationally. The company's products include diesel engine, gas, steam, heat engine, electric, chemical kinetic, marine nuclear, electromechanical, and other power equipment, as well as related auxiliary equipment. Its products are used in automobiles, ships, marine engineering, ocean-going fishing vessels, yachts, and land power plants, coalbed methane power generation, as well as nuclear power, oil fields, special vehicles, construction machinery, and other industries. The company was formerly known as Sail Co., Ltd. and changed its name to China Shipbuilding Industry Group Power Co., Ltd. in April 2016. China Shipbuilding Industry Group Power Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Beijing, the People's Republic of China.
business_summary_ko: 중국조선공업그룹전력유한회사(China Shipbuilding Industry Group Power Co., Ltd.)는 중국 및 해외에 전력 장비를 제조 및 공급하고 있습니다. 회사의 제품에는 디젤 엔진, 가스, 증기, 열 엔진, 전기, 화학 운동, 해양 원자력, 전기 기계 및 기타 전력 장비와 관련 보조 장비가 포함됩니다. 당사의 제품은 자동차, 선박, 해양공학, 원양어선, 요트, 육상발전소, 석탄층 메탄발전, 원자력발전, 유전, 특수차량, 건설기계 및 기타 산업에 사용됩니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Sail Co., Ltd.로 알려졌으며 2016년 4월에 China Shipbuilding Industry Group Power Co., Ltd.로 이름을 변경했습니다. China Shipbuilding Industry Group Power Co., Ltd.는 2000년에 설립되었으며 중화인민공화국 베이징에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
